_note: Physical pump-meter cumulative readings (source of truth for lake water extraction). Entered via the admin dashboard. Each interval's delta is spread across irrigation-season days by scripts/pump_meter.py. Telemetry flow is deliberately NOT used (Grundfos estimate only). Meter units: 1 unit = 1000 L = 1 kL (confirmed 28 Sep 2026 against pump run-hours).

das._note: The WaterNSW DAS/LID over-reads EXACTLY 10x (confirmed from the DAS export, Oct 2026: DAS 121.790 ML vs physical 12.176 ML, 3 Aug-28 Sep). A reading entered with source=DAS is stored as true kL = raw*scale + offset_kl, so it divides by 10 and aligns to the physical meter dial. offset_kl is re-anchored to the latest physical read: 6 Oct 2026 greenkeeper dial 515992.5 vs DAS register 5055194 -> offset 10473.1 (was 10475.7 off the 28 Sep anchor; ~2.6 kL LID drift over 8 days). IMPORTANT: once WaterNSW corrects the LID scaling, set scale=1 and offset_kl=0.
